info.title: OpenHall API
info.description: Self-hosted school presence and movement platform API.

operatorCredential.name: Authorization
operatorCredential.description: One-time operator credential: `Bootstrap <token>` on bootstrap prepare, `Recovery <token>` on recovery consume. Never sent in query or cookies.

503.description: A required dependency is unavailable or not current.

get.description: Returns the current session. Anonymous callers receive authenticated:false. Authenticated callers receive a stable per-session CSRF token derived from the session credential; reading never mutates authentication state.
Minimal canonical identity for the authenticated person (self-only).
Public login metadata. Returns tenant/provider display info for a single-tenant installation or a known slug; otherwise requires tenant selection without enumerating slugs.
Starts an OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE (S256) login. Responds 302 to the provider authorization URL. Status documented: 302 success; 400/502 problem on failure.

302.description: Redirect to the provider authorization URL

schema.description: Redirect to the provider authorization URL

400.description: Login cannot start

post.description: Starts an OIDC enrollment from a one-time invitation. The raw enrollment token travels in the Authorization header (`Enrollment <token>`), never the query string. Responds 200 with the provider authorization URL; the invitation is consumed only at callback. Status documented: 200 success; 400/401/502 problem on failure.

400.description: Enrollment cannot start

get.description: OIDC callback. Always responds 302: success redirects to the safe local return path with a fresh HttpOnly session cookie; failure redirects to /?error=<code> with a safe machine-readable code. OIDC protections (state/browser binding/nonce/PKCE/replay) apply instead of the SPA CSRF header.

302.description: Redirect to the return path (success) or /?error=<code> (failure)

Set-Cookie.description: Fresh session cookie on success (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax)

schema.description: Redirect to the return path (success) or /?error=<code> (failure)

post.description: Revokes the current session. Requires the session cookie, the X-CSRF-Token header, and a same-origin request.
Revokes every session for the account by bumping session_revision. Requires the session cookie, the X-CSRF-Token header, and a same-origin request.
Consumes a one-time recovery grant from the Authorization header (never query) and creates a short-lived recovery session.

get.description: Reports whether initialization is required. Reveals nothing about active bootstrap tokens.

post.description: Validates tenant/school/admin details plus the OIDC provider (live discovery), stores the encrypted draft, and starts the bootstrap OIDC flow. The operator credential travels in the Authorization header, never query or ambient cookies.

400.description: Invalid setup details or provider configuration

409.description: Installation already exists

post.description: Verifies the one-time setup code without consuming it and without creating anything. The token travels in the Authorization header, never query, body, or cookies.

409.description: Installation already exists

post.description: Creates the canonical school installation without an external identity provider and returns a temporary setup session. Consumes the one-time setup code exactly once. The token travels in the Authorization header, never query, body, or cookies.

400.description: Invalid school or administrator details

409.description: Installation already exists

post.description: Starts the first school sign-in connection for an initialized school. Cookie-authenticated with CSRF and same-origin protection; the caller must hold tenant system-admin authority. Setup sessions may prepare; authorized recovery sessions may complete setup. Rejects with a 409 conflict when a provider is already connected. Never creates a canonical provider before OIDC succeeds.

400.description: Invalid provider configuration

409.description: School sign-in is already connected

get.description: Schools the authenticated person may legitimately enter right now. Recovery sessions are rejected.
What the authenticated person may do in one exact school, plus their own schedule context. Unknown or inaccessible schools return 404 without revealing existence.

post.description: Request a pass for the authenticated student. The target student and request source are server-derived. Requires Idempotency-Key (OpenHall API contract, not a finalized IETF RFC). Success returns ETag for the pass revision. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed destination, student, or pass resource

409.description: Active pass exists, key reused, invalid transition, or destination unavailable

post.description: Staff-created pass request for a student. Organization-level pass.create.student is attempted first; denied teachers fall back to the resolved current section. Requires Idempotency-Key (OpenHall API contract). Success returns ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed destination, student, or pass resource

409.description: Active pass exists, key reused, invalid transition, or destination unavailable

get.description: Read the authenticated student’s current active pass, or pass:null. Cookie-authenticated; not CSRF-protected. Success returns ETag when a pass exists. Cache-Control: no-store.

post.description: Self-cancel an own student_web pass in requested/queued/ready. Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong ETag in If-Match; missing If-Match is 428, stale is 412. Idempotent replay returns the stored success. Success returns the new ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed destination, student, or pass resource

409.description: Active pass exists, key reused, invalid transition, or destination unavailable

get.description: Pending standard approvals the authenticated principal may resolve. Cookie-authenticated; not CSRF-protected. Cache-Control: no-store.

post.description: Resolve one exact standard approval requirement (approve). Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong pass ETag in If-Match. Success returns the new pass ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed approval, override, or pass resource

409.description: Invalid workflow state or no overrideable blocker

post.description: Resolve one exact standard approval requirement (deny). Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong pass ETag in If-Match. Success returns the new pass ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed approval, override, or pass resource

409.description: Invalid workflow state or no overrideable blocker

post.description: Request rule-specific overrides for the authenticated student’s own pass. Body carries only a category; blockers are server-derived. Requires Idempotency-Key and If-Match. Success returns the pass ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed approval, override, or pass resource

409.description: Invalid workflow state or no overrideable blocker

post.description: Staff override request for a student pass. Authorized resolvers collapse authorized-mode request+approval atomically; approval_required blockers stay pending. Body carries only a category. Requires Idempotency-Key and If-Match. Success returns the pass ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed approval, override, or pass resource

409.description: Invalid workflow state or no overrideable blocker

get.description: Pending rule-specific overrides the authenticated principal may resolve, honoring each override’s escalation tier. Cookie-authenticated; not CSRF-protected. Cache-Control: no-store.

post.description: Resolve one exact rule-specific override (approve). Approval_required overrides need an independent school-tier approver. Requires Idempotency-Key and If-Match. Success returns the new pass ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed approval, override, or pass resource

409.description: Invalid workflow state or no overrideable blocker

post.description: Resolve one exact rule-specific override (deny). Approval_required overrides need an independent school-tier approver. Requires Idempotency-Key and If-Match. Success returns the new pass ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed approval, override, or pass resource

409.description: Invalid workflow state or no overrideable blocker

post.description: Start the authenticated student’s own ready pass. Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong ETag in If-Match. Only an explicit departure establishes that the student left. Success returns the new ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed pass, destination, or station resource

409.description: Invalid movement state, expired offer, or destination conflict

post.description: Staff starts a student’s ready pass, for example when the student carries no device. Organization-level staff authority first, teacher fallback against the current section. Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong ETag in If-Match. Success returns the new ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed pass, destination, or station resource

409.description: Invalid movement state, expired offer, or destination conflict

post.description: Self arrival for check_in_mode = optional destinations only. Required destinations need station check-in; none destinations take no arrival checkpoint. Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong ETag in If-Match. Success returns the new ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed pass, destination, or station resource

409.description: Invalid movement state, expired offer, or destination conflict

post.description: Begin the return from at_destination. Releases destination capacity. Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong ETag in If-Match. Success returns the new ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed pass, destination, or station resource

409.description: Invalid movement state, expired offer, or destination conflict

post.description: Complete the student’s own active movement. The normal lightweight path is outbound -> completed with no fabricated arrival or return checkpoints. Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong ETag in If-Match. Success returns the new ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed pass, destination, or station resource

409.description: Invalid movement state, expired offer, or destination conflict

post.description: Destination station records arrival for optional/required destinations. The pass destination must equal the route destination. Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong ETag in If-Match. Success returns the new ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed pass, destination, or station resource

409.description: Invalid movement state, expired offer, or destination conflict

post.description: Destination station records that the student left the destination. Releases capacity. The pass destination must equal the route destination. Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong ETag in If-Match. Success returns the new ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed pass, destination, or station resource

409.description: Invalid movement state, expired offer, or destination conflict

post.description: Destination staff explicitly ends a movement at the destination (one-way workflows). Requires a prior explicit arrival. Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong ETag in If-Match. Success returns the new ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed pass, destination, or station resource

409.description: Invalid movement state, expired offer, or destination conflict

get.description: Read the authenticated student’s own derived queue position. Position is computed on every read and never stored, so this dynamic resource carries no pass ETag. Other students’ passes are concealed as 404; a non-queued owned pass is 409. Cache-Control: no-store.

409.description: Pass is not currently queued

get.description: Minimized operational station view for authorized destination staff. No grants, rule JSON, or student schedule history. Dynamic aggregates carry no ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.
Minimized active movement for a section, authorized only through the canonical teaching relationship or existing administrator capability. Cache-Control: no-store.
Current active students in an authorized teaching section. Returns names only; people.view is not required. Cache-Control: no-store.
Minimized active movement across one school. Requires pass.view.school_live for that exact school. Cache-Control: no-store.
Same-origin, cookie-authenticated SSE invalidation stream. Events contain topics only; REST remains authoritative and no durable replay is promised.
List school locations for administration. Requires destination.manage on the exact school. Cache-Control: no-store.

post.description: Create a school location (status active, revision 1). Requires Idempotency-Key. Cache-Control: no-store.

409.description: Resource in use, duplicate, or invalid state

get.description: Stable safe destination catalog for organization members (active destinations, picker-safe fields only). Cache-Control: no-store.
School audit feed for administration. Requires audit.view on the exact school. Keyset pagination over (occurred_at DESC, id DESC); metadata is never projected. Cache-Control: no-store.
List schedule blocks with the current strong schedule ETag. Requires schedule.view on the exact school. Cache-Control: no-store.

post.description: Create a schedule template with its full slot set (validated atomically: active same-school blocks, non-overlapping slots; ordinals derived from sorted order). Requires Idempotency-Key and the schedule If-Match. Cache-Control: no-store.

put.description: Replace policy configuration (revision + 1). Active rules may be edited; the new revision governs future evaluations while old snapshots stay authoritative. Requires Idempotency-Key and If-Match. Cache-Control: no-store.

409.description: Resource in use, duplicate, or invalid state

409.description: Resource in use, duplicate, or invalid state

get.description: List explicit staff duties for administration. Requires authorization.manage on the exact school. Cache-Control: no-store.

get.description: List staff-directed appointments. Requires scheduled_authorization.manage on the exact school. Cache-Control: no-store.
